violation_type.title: If a subject of a background check at your operation has been arrested or charged with a crime, you must report it to Licensing immediately (26 TAC §745.665)
violation_type.short_title: If a subject of a background check at your operation has been arrested or charged with a crime, you must report it to Licensing immediately
violation_type.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that an individual at the operation who is required to have a background check was arrested.  The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation as required.

finding_variants.text: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that an individual at the operation who is required to have a background check was arrested.  The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation as required.

The owner of the operation states that she was unaware that she had a warrant out for her arrest, until she was arrested by law enforcement in april 2026.  She states that after she was arrested she was informed that a warrant was issued out for her arrest in January 2026. She states that she was unaware that she had to report the arrest to Licensing.
